records.speaker: Speakerless original546B8 system status
records.context: Read as one original Search event: a selected discovery voice reports the hot spring, original signed recovery requests15 and clamps stored fatigue at0, then the original skill/RNG test may allow a selected relaxation voice, original effect and Experience notice310. Alternatives in each table are not sequential replies. Logical role1 selects the original actor; actual representative is Gerhard16, not proof of a physically assigned First Mate. Other fatigue contexts include original +3 Search failure, +/-5 oasis/mirage and -10 friendly village. Recovery text displays the requested magnitude, not necessarily the post-clamp delta. No branch, actor, RNG, fatigue, effect or outcome is forced. The hot-spring taste joke and subjective refreshed impressions remain intact. Statuses use literal x0, speech uses original x6; compilers own layout. Neighbors and opposite consumers are contextual references only.
records.source_meaning: Fatigue has increased by the substituted amount.
records.localization_note: Fatigue increased by %s. is a concise natural system notice for 疲労度が%s上がりました. It preserves the direction and the original requested adjustment, not a new total or an independently measured post-clamp change. Keep the one original full-width decimal substitution; do not invent points, a percent unit, health damage or a speaker.

It retains the original requested recovery magnitude, even when stored fatigue reaches the zero clamp before that whole amount can be subtracted.
